These terms govern the use of the EjeSpot community platform and the content you share with other travelers.
We want you to know what information we use to personalize your experience and how you can control it.

EjeSpot is a community network aimed at promoting responsible and inclusive tourism in the Coffee Region. By creating an account you agree to use the app respectfully toward other users, local communities and the environment.

By posting reviews, photos or suggestions you guarantee that the information is truthful and that you have the rights to share it. EjeSpot may moderate or remove posts that violate community rules or contain misleading information.

XP points, medals and levels are symbolic acknowledgements within the platform. They do not represent real money and cannot be transferred, sold or redeemed for cash. Rewards may be adjusted to keep things fair among users.

Information about schedules, prices and locations is for reference and may change. Each user is responsible for verifying the conditions of the place, carrying the right equipment and respecting the environmental rules of each destination.
EjeSpot may update these terms to reflect service improvements. We will notify relevant changes within the app. If you have questions, write to us at hola@ejespot.co.

We collect your name, username, email, approximate location and the content you share (reviews, photos and suggested points). In this academic phase the data is managed only in memory during the session.
We use your data to personalize recommendations, show nearby spots, calculate your progress in the community and keep a safe environment for all travelers.
Location is used only while you use the app to show nearby places and calculate routes. You can disable this permission from your device settings or from the App Permissions section.

Your reviews and suggestions are visible to the community. You can delete your account and your content from the danger zone in settings. Uploaded photos will be associated with the places you visited.
You can request access, correction or deletion of your data by writing to privacidad@ejespot.co. We will handle your request within a maximum of 15 business days and at no cost.
Write to us at hola@ejespot.co and our team will reply within 48 hours.

Verified by a Local Ambassador. It is now visible to the whole community.
Verified by a Local Ambassador. It is one of the most visited trails.
The sunrise among the wax palms is unbeatable. I went early (6:30 a.m.) and there were hardly any tourists. The light over the mountain range is magical.
The full trail takes almost 5 hours up to the hummingbird house. Definitely bring mountain boots and local cash.
The trout with patacón is incredible and the view of the coffee plantations is unbeatable. The single-origin coffee at the end was the perfect finish.
Very good customer service, generous and fresh food. A 100% country-style atmosphere, ideal for going with family.
Climbing the Polish Corridor of the Cathedral is a must-do. The panorama of Manizales and the snow-capped peaks is beyond compare.
The sound of the water along the whole trail connects you with nature. Wear footwear with good grip because there are wet rocks.
The tour is very complete and the guide explains with a lot of passion. The final tasting is of the highest quality.
The cold water cascades next to the thermal pools create a truly unique contrast.
The Filandia viewpoint at sunset is one of the prettiest plans in the Coffee Region.
Ideal for going with family. The butterfly house and the palm trail are very educational.
The night view of Manizales from Chipre is spectacular. Bring a jacket for the cold.
The best single-origin coffee I tried on the trip. The V60 preparation is flawless.
The colorful houses and the village atmosphere are perfect for a relaxed walk.
It is worth spending the whole day there. The coffee show is very pretty and the rides for kids are well taken care of.
A quiet viewpoint to watch the sunset. Getting there by car is the most comfortable option.
A great half-day plan among the coffee plantations. The host farm treated us wonderfully.
An entertaining tour to understand the coffee process and the history of the region.
The waterfall is gorgeous and the trail is well marked. Hopefully they verify it soon.
The acoustics are excellent and the program very varied. A perfect plan for a cultural night in Manizales.
Amazing pieces, very well cared for. The free entry makes it a must-do plan in Armenia.
The weaving workshops are great and very affordable. A good way to get to know the local culture.
Perfect for going with kids. The lake and the picnic areas are very well maintained and it is affordable.
The canopy is spectacular and the guides very professional. The adrenaline and the scenery are worth every peso.
The night view is very pretty and the live music gives it a special atmosphere. Get there early to get a table.
The dishes are generous and full of local flavor. The view of the snow-capped peaks from the table is a huge plus.
An unforgettable experience. The landscape of the wax palms is impressive. I recommend going early in the morning.
The trout with patacón and the single-origin coffee are the perfect combination. Very friendly service.
The Polish Corridor of the Cathedral offers an incredible panorama of the city and the snow-capped peaks.
A short but demanding trail because of the humidity. The 70-meter waterfall is worth every step.
The coffee tour is very easy to follow and the final tasting is of the highest quality. A must.
An 11 km trail among the tallest wax palms in the world, a symbol of the Coffee Region. Ideal for a medium-difficulty hike. Bring warm and waterproof clothing for the fog.
A complete gastronomic and coffee experience. Enjoy typical Quindío cuisine with local ingredients and a guided single-origin coffee tasting.
The historic and cultural center of Manizales with the imposing Metropolitan Cathedral Basilica (the tallest in Colombia at 106 m) and the iconic Bolívar Cóndor monument by Rodrigo Arenas Betancourt.
A traditional coffee farm with a walk through the plantation, the processing area, the butterfly house and a final tasting. The tour explains the whole process from bean to cup.
Natural thermal waters surrounded by cloud forest, with pools at different temperatures and cold water cascades. An ideal plan to rest after hiking.
The most photogenic viewpoint in Quindío: a wooden tower on the hill with a 360° view of the coffee plantations and the mountain range. A must at sunset.
An educational reserve with a butterfly house, a wax palm trail and a fern collection. An excellent short plan for going with family.
A natural balcony over Manizales with the best night view of the lit-up city. Bring a jacket: the temperature drops a lot.
A specialty coffee shop renowned in Salento. Its V60 preparation and its single-origin coffee are a reference for coffee lovers.
Cobbled streets, colorful houses with wooden balconies and the coffee street. The base town for exploring the Cocora Valley.
A theme park dedicated to coffee with mechanical rides, a coffee show, a museum and gardens. The most complete plan for a full day.
A quiet viewpoint on the outskirts of Pereira with views of the valley and the snow-capped peaks in the background. A good spot to watch the sunset without crowds.
A half-day tour through coffee plantations with host farms that teach harvesting, pulping and traditional drying of the bean.
An interactive museum about the history of coffee in Quindío, with a guided tour, a model of the process and a coffee shop at the end of the visit.
One of the most iconic cultural venues in Manizales: theater, concerts and festivals all year round. A varied program and great acoustics.
An archaeological collection of the Quimbaya culture with pieces in gold, pottery and silverwork. Free entry and guided tours that explain the pre-Columbian history of the region.
A cultural center with local art exhibitions, weaving workshops and folk performances. A meeting point for artisans and artists from Quindío.
A family park with green areas, playgrounds, a lake and a bike path. Ideal for a weekend plan with recreational activities and picnics.
An adventure park with canopy, suspension bridges, zipline and horseback rides among the mountains. An adrenaline plan for groups and adventurous families.
A night plan with a panoramic view of the valley, live music on weekends and hot drinks. Ideal to end a day of exploring.
Author cuisine with ingredients from the Coffee Region: trout, plantain, beans and coffee desserts. A country-style atmosphere and a view of the snow-capped peaks.
A protected nature reserve with an ecological hiking trail through cloud forest that ends at an impressive 70-meter natural waterfall.
A 40-meter waterfall in the middle of the humid forest, suggested by the community and pending verification by a moderator.
